reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing the main-red PostgreSQL recovery-control tests
reason: Three PostgreSQL cases in test_recovery_controls.py failed on main back to at least #1264: every held-recovery control (goal pause, turn stop) ended as a 503 'failed in the project worker before it saved anything'. The recovery fixture in test_recovery_reconciliation.py built its synthetic worker bootstrap with pool_settings=None, so the recovery-control runner's own PostgreSQL Database fell back to PoolSettings.from_environment() and raised 'NEBULA_V3_DB_ADMIN_RESERVE is required'. A real supervisor always hands its workers its pool settings (runtime_service -> RuntimeProcessHost -> WorkerBootstrap), so no product change is needed; the fixture now passes the batch fixture's SETTINGS as the bootstrap dict. A subagent validated the cause independently and ruled out the execution SQL guard. CI now provisions PostgreSQL when either recovery test file is selected, so these variants cannot go stale unseen again. Selected: both recovery test files in full (SQLite and PostgreSQL).
exclusions: No product code, UI, native or Playwright change. Locally 53 passed (SQLite and PostgreSQL) with no NEBULA_V3_DB_* variables set.
